personal.name: Gowri Prasath
personal.title: Senior Software Developer
personal.subTitle: Specializing in full-stack engineering, cloud-native architectures, and application modernization for high-availability enterprise environments.
personal.bio: Passionate Software Developer with 4.5 years of experience specializing in full-stack development, distributed architectures, and legacy-to-cloud modernization within large-scale banking and capital markets. Proven track record of architecting concurrent Golang microservices and building highly responsive, WCAG-compliant Angular applications for enterprise systems. I thrive on clean architecture principles, robust DevSecOps practices, and delivering scalable, secure digital solutions.

items: Azure SQL / Oracle SQL / MS SQL / PostgreSQL

description: Led migration of legacy applications from Java & Java Struts to Golang & Angular, improving system performance, scalability, and maintainability while quickly adapting to new technologies.
Designed and developed scalable microservices using Golang, leveraging concurrency patterns (goroutines, channels) to handle high-throughput workloads.
Built and integrated RESTful APIs and third-party market data services, enabling real-time data streaming using Server-Sent Events (SSE), marking a key initiative for the team.
Developed and enhanced Angular applications, including major upgrades from v8/9 to v17/18, improving performance, maintainability, SEO, and ensuring long-term framework support.
Implemented frontend features such as web crawling support, cookie consent, and cross-platform optimizations to enhance user experience and compliance.
Designed and implemented CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps/Jenkins for microservices, enabling automated build, test, and deployment workflows.
Standardized and enhanced Helm-based deployment strategies for OpenShift, improving release consistency and operational efficiency.
Containerized and deployed applications on OpenShift, leveraging Kubernetes concepts such as orchestration, scaling, and resource management.
Owning and managing 10+ business-critical microservices (frontend and backend), handling end-to-end lifecycle including development, deployment, monitoring, and production support.
Collaborated in Agile teams, contributing to system design, code reviews, and performance optimization initiatives.
Contributed to full-stack development, bug resolution, and unit testing using Karma and Jasmine across capital markets applications.
Assisted in DB migrations (Oracle to Azure SQL) and automated test workflows using proprietary automation frameworks.
Authored comprehensive test cases to achieve 90%+ code coverage, ensuring application stability and production readiness.

projects.title: CDR (Canadian Depositary Receipts)
projects.subtitle: Capital Markets - Asset Pricing & Shareholder Voting
projects.description: A high-availability capital markets ecosystem managing real-time market pricing synchronization, shareholder voting for Corporate Actions, and administrative portal workflows. Features a dedicated Market Data Microservice integrated with Refinitiv (LSEG) APIs via WebSockets and Server-Sent Events (SSE) to stream low-latency pricing updates.

projects.title: OII (Online Insurance Inquiry)
projects.subtitle: Cards Technology - Legacy Modernization & ETL
projects.description: A highly regulated system allowing insurance advisors to verify travel medical coverage. Orchestrated the transition from a Java Struts monolith to Golang microservices, executed secure Oracle-to-Azure SQL data migration of sensitive user profiles via Go-ORM, and integrated mTLS claim retrievals.

projects.title: Securitization
projects.subtitle: Capital Markets - ABCP Conduit Management
projects.description: Enterprise platform supporting Asset-Backed Commercial Paper (ABCP) debt operations. Modernized backend to Go, upgraded frontend to Angular v20 with Signals, integrated Solace messaging for publication alerts, and resolved firewall-restricted build issues via a JFrog-backed Go module proxy.

projects.title: go-gmail
projects.subtitle: Open Source Go Library
projects.description: A fluent, rate-limited Go wrapper for the official Gmail API. Enables building complex MIME emails with a clean, chainable API while automatically protecting your Google account from API quota blocks using intelligent rate limiting.

projects.title: CWF (Common Web Framework)
projects.subtitle: Capital Markets - Shared Angular Library
projects.description: An enterprise-grade, accessibility-compliant Angular-based framework distributed as an internal npm package. Establishes standardized reusable UI/UX elements, layout patterns, and automated accessibility testing (a11y) workflows using Axe DevTools to ensure WCAG compliance.

projects.title: CAH - Admin Authentication Module
projects.subtitle: Shared Platform Technology- Role-Based Portal
projects.description: Secure administrative portal for configuration and cryptographic operations (encryption/hashing) using Microsoft Entra ID. Features a role-based request/approval workflow, multi-factor authentication, bilingual support (i18n), and OpenShift Service Mesh integration.

projects.title: FICC Strategy
projects.subtitle: Capital Markets - Research Portal Security Hardening
projects.description: Frontline backend server and web app for FICC Strategy research. Enhanced the security posture of the platform by mitigating penetration testing vulnerabilities, shifting environment configurations behind a Go reverse proxy, and implementing rate-limited server-side CAPTCHA.
